comment: The LHR is described as maintaining a longitudinal record while allowing centralised, federated, or hybrid implementation. “Maintains” may incorrectly suggest that all conformant implementations persist a consolidated national record.

public.text: The LHR is described as maintaining a longitudinal record while allowing centralised, federated, or hybrid implementation. “Maintains” may incorrectly suggest that all conformant implementations persist a consolidated national record.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace with sentecne like: “provides governed longitudinal access to an individual’s health information, whether through consolidated storage, federated retrieval, or a hybrid arrangement.”
